records.command:
git diff --numstat -- classic/apps/web/src/timeline/components/timeline-element.tsx
git diff --check
rg -n 'mediaMap: new Map\(.*filter|mediaAssets.*filter.*video' classic/apps/web/src --glob '*.{ts,tsx}' | head -20
node classic/scripts/local-production/build.mjs --stage

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('classic/apps/web/src/timeline/components/timeline-element.tsx');s=p.read_text();old='''	const clipMediaAssets = useEditorMedia((currentEditor) =>
		currentEditor.media
			.getAssets()
			.filter((asset) => asset.type === "image" || asset.type === "video"),
	);''';new='''	const allMediaAssets = useEditorMedia((currentEditor) => currentEditor.media.getAssets());
	const clipMediaAssets = useMemo(() => allMediaAssets.filter((asset) => asset.type === "image" || asset.type === "video"), [allMediaAssets]);''';assert old in s;s=s.replace(old,new,1).replace('mediaMap: new Map(clipMediaAssets.map((a) => [a.id, a])),','mediaMap: new Map(allMediaAssets.map((a) => [a.id, a])),');p.write_text(s)
p=Path('classic/apps/web/src/media/__tests__/unified-angles-audio.test.ts');s=p.read_text().replace('import { createUnifiedAnglesAsset }','import { createUnifiedAnglesAsset, getUnifiedAngleRange }');anchor='\tconst mediaAssets = [first, second, mic, virtual];';assert anchor in s;s=s.replace(anchor,anchor+'''
    expect(getUnifiedAngleRange({asset:virtual,angleAssetId:"two",mediaMap:new Map(mediaAssets.map(a=>[a.id,a])),trimStart:5,duration:4}).available).toBe(true);
    expect(getUnifiedAngleRange({asset:virtual,angleAssetId:"two",mediaMap:new Map([first,second,virtual].map(a=>[a.id,a])),trimStart:5,duration:4}).available).toBe(false);
''',1);p.write_text(s)
PY
node classic/node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --write classic/apps/web/src/timeline/components/timeline-element.tsx classic/apps/web/src/media/__tests__/unified-angles-audio.test.ts
node classic/scripts/test-web.mjs src/media/__tests__/unified-angles-audio.test.ts --jobs=1 --report=.local/unified-with-audio-2026-10-20/angle-regression
node classic/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p classic/apps/web/tsconfig.build.json
